title: perf(console): the sidebar no longer redraws every entry each time the console re-renders during first load
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu2qzrpapiEtaSS8VNGQmWkU)_

Part of #37444. Part of #37575. This is the first render-CPU cut: the sidebar's redraw cascade during the shell's boot re-renders. Both cards stay open: the larger render cost left on the list page is the grid's own re-render passes after its data lands and the per-row Radix mounts, which this PR deliberately leaves alone to stay small and easy to review.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：所有用户打开控制台任意页面时，左侧导航不再在首屏加载期间被反复整栏重画；导航显示和操作（收藏、复制链接、在新标签打开）都不变，只是首屏更快。
- 为什么做：属于「首屏 2.5 秒」卡的渲染 CPU 一刀（#37575）。HTTP/2 口径下中位数：首页 2227，列表页 2675，记录页 2561 毫秒；首页已在 2.5 秒内，列表和记录页还差一些。
- 出错会怎样：最坏情况是某个导航项的文字、图标或颜色在它的数据变化后没有及时刷新，或右键菜单用到了旧的回调；新测试分别锁住了这两种情况，改动可以整笔撤回。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

While a Console page first loads, the shell re-renders about ten times as its boot reads land (auth, org, app list, permissions, translations). Each pass redrew every navigation entry, and with it each entry's ⋯ menu and tooltip: about 2,700 components a pass on the showcase app. A fiber census of the list page before 3 s counted 28,860 re-rendered components; after this change, 11.4k–14k.

- `ui/packages/layout/src/NavigationRenderer.tsx`: the row renderer is wrapped in `React.memo` with a comparator, `sameRowAnswers`. Every prop is compared by identity except the three target resolvers (`resolveTargetLabel`, `resolveTargetIcon`, `resolveTargetColor`); when those are new functions, the comparator compares what they answer for this row (the resolved label, icon and, for object rows, colour) instead. A group row always re-renders when a resolver changes, so its children are compared one by one. The inline props type became the named `NavItemRendererProps`.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/UnifiedSidebar.tsx`: the template context passed to the nav keeps its identity while the user id, org id and context values are unchanged (keyed on their JSON), and the row action renderer is built by a module helper, `navItemActionRenderer`, memoised on `togglePin` and `activeApp`.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/SidebarItemMenu.tsx`: the menu is split into a thin shell (hooks, open state, a latest-callbacks ref written in a layout effect, stable `toggleFavorite` / `copyLink`) and a memoised `SidebarItemMenuView` that receives only strings and stable callbacks, so the DropdownMenu tree redraws only when its own text or entries change.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx`: the expression user is built once per auth user (`useMemo`) and the provider's empty `data` is a module constant. Rebuilding both on every render gave `ExpressionProvider` a new value each pass, which alone made every visibility-gated entry redraw.

No behaviour, string, route or saved document changes. Changeset: `patch` on `@object-ui/layout`, `@object-ui/app-shell`, `@object-ui/console`, `@objectstack/console` (the Console dist ships the change).

## Tests

- New `ui/packages/layout/src/__tests__/NavigationRenderer.rowMemo-37575.test.tsx` (5 tests) counts `renderItemAction` calls across rerenders: same props redraw no row; new resolvers with the same answers redraw no row; one changed label redraws only that row; a group's children are compared one by one; a new `evaluateVisibility` redraws every row. Ablation: without the memo, 4 of 5 fail; with a plain `React.memo` (no comparator), 3 of 5 fail.
- New `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/__tests__/SidebarItemMenu.latestCallbacks-37575.test.tsx` (2 tests): after a rerender, the favourite toggle calls the newest callback, and Copy link copies the newest address while the trigger is renamed. Ablation: capturing the callback at mount instead of through the ref fails 1 of 2.
- `@object-ui/layout` and `@object-ui/app-shell` tests (347 files, 3246 tests) passed before the last two edits (the ref write moved into a layout effect, the action renderer moved to a module helper); after them, the 49 files touching the sidebar, the menu and the nav renderer (346 tests) passed again.
- `tsc --noEmit` exit 0 in `ui/packages/layout` and `ui/packages/app-shell`, for both `tsconfig.json` and `tsconfig.test.json`.
- `eslint` over the changed `ui/` files: 0 errors. One advisory React-compiler warning remains in `UnifiedSidebar.tsx` (`preserve-manual-memoization`, "activeApp may be modified later"); the build does not use the React compiler.

## Acceptance notes

- **Measured effect** — production build (`pnpm console:build` at this head), `objectstack start` with `NODE_ENV=production`, behind a local HTTP/2 TLS front (the card's acceptance condition, #37444 ruling 7205984444), Lighthouse 13.6.0 desktop preset, Chrome for Testing 158 headless, 4-core container, signed in, cold cache. Five runs per page for HTTP/2, three for the HTTP/1.1 control through the same front:

  | Page | h2 before (main `9476092c`) | h2 after (this branch) | h1 before | h1 after |
  |:--|--:|--:|--:|--:|
  | Home | 2297 | 2227 (2227, 2338, 2258, 2197, 2204) | 3689 | 3658 |
  | Object list | 2837 | 2675 (2743, 2675, 2693, 2642, 2671) | 4788 | 4778 |
  | Record page | 2685 | 2561 (2561, 2606, 2531, 2527, 2562) | 4309 | 4468 |

  h2 gains: home −70, list −162, record −124 ms. Home stays under 2500 ms; list misses by 175 ms and record by 61 ms. The HTTP/1.1 control does not move outside its noise (3 runs; record's h1 runs spread 4227–4607): over HTTP/1.1 the first screen waits on queued script requests, so render CPU is not on its critical path there.
- **What is left, from what-if runs on this build (h2, 2 runs each):** halving all simulated main-thread CPU (parse, compile, script and render together) gives list 2351 / record 2333; at one twentieth, 2290 / 2256. With unlimited bandwidth, both are about 1.5 s. So CPU, of which render is one part, is worth at most about 0.4 s on the list page, while bytes are worth about 1.2 s; the bytes slice (#37572) is the next cut. Dropping the whole navigation is an upper bound of list 2609; dropping only the per-row tooltip and ⋯ menu gives 2635, so the sidebar is now near its floor.
- The remaining render cost on the list page is the grid: 4–5 re-render passes after data lands (the measurement layout effects in `data-table.tsx`, 550–1080 components each) and the per-row Radix mount re-render (about 1,160 components). Out of scope here by the seat's ruling, recorded on #37575.
- L2 owed (not self-reviewed): no contract-tier read needed (no governed path; no spec or protocol change).

## Verification

Two-minute check: `cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/layout/src/__tests__/NavigationRenderer.rowMemo-37575.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/layout/__tests__/SidebarItemMenu.latestCallbacks-37575.test.tsx` → 7 passed.

Read first: `sameRowAnswers` in `NavigationRenderer.tsx` (every prop that reaches a row must be either identity-compared or answer-compared; a prop it skipped would leave a stale row), then the shell/view split in `SidebarItemMenu.tsx`.
